Preserve original character's face/identity, hairstyle, clothes, footwear, body proportions, realistic miniature rendering and softly lit physical material appearance. Hands EMPTY throughout every frame, both hands visible as anatomically appropriate, no props. All cells must use identical orthographic-like fixed camera, figure scale and centered pivot, and a shallow pale round display base of identical size.

Top row cell 2 = 45-degree three-quarter front view, rotating toward own LEFT, nose toward viewer's RIGHT. Both arms relaxed down.
